resources.string: A counter in the corner: frames per second and milliseconds per frame.

An Xbox 360 disc ISO is read in place, taking no extra space. Or a folder with the extracted game, copied to Internal storage/%1$s (7.3 GB). With the ISO, the native renderer\'s fh2_shaders.nfsp goes next to it or in %1$s.
A frame a little late for the screen is shown at once instead of waiting for the next one. It does not change the FPS; turn it off if you notice judder.
Above Normal the sound may distort at its peaks.
Asks for root (Magisk, KernelSU) and adds the game\'s full crash files, the kernel log and the whole logcat to the zip. Read only: nothing is changed.
Choose the game\'s extracted folder (with default.xex, the two .xex DLLs and media). It will be copied to Internal storage/%1$s (7.3 GB).
Choose what vibrates when the game requests rumble.

One flag per word, like --nfsmw_nativo_sin_desenfoque=true. Flags the game reads while it runs apply at once; the others are saved and count at the next start. It is the same list as Extra game options in the launcher.
Accepted now does not always mean visible: a few parts of the game only read a flag when it starts.
Copying the game to Internal storage/
Could not find that ISO\'s path. Pick the file through the internal storage or the memory card (in the picker, menu ☰ → the device name), not through \"Recent\".
Could not load the diagnostics library
Could not open the target file.
Draws the game\'s small images, like the reflections, only at the size they need instead of the whole screen\'s: less work for the GPU. When needed, it goes back to full size on its own.
Every frame shown moves the game forward by exactly one step, instead of 0 or 2 when the frame rate is below 30. Turn it off to compare.
Emulated: imitates the Xbox 360\'s GPU. The most faithful to the console\'s image, but much slower.
Every language on the disc: texts, menus and the sat nav voice. The ones marked voiced also have the dialogue in that language. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Experimental. Copies the scene\'s image only when an effect needs it, like the raindrops, and spares the GPU the rest of the time. It turns itself off if it sees a difference.
Experimental. When the game reuses an image it drew, it is copied straight on the GPU, which is faster. Turn it off if an image looks wrong.

Export copies your progress (profile and saves). Import replaces the current progress with an export or one of the automatic backups (jogos/%1$s-saves). To take the save to another phone, copy the exported folder to the same place on it and import.
Extra sharpness on top of CAS or FSR: 0 keeps the default. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Faces of the car\'s reflection map redrawn every frame.
fh2_shaders.nfsp, next to the game files (%1$s). Without it the native renderer has no translated shaders.
FIFO follows the screen\'s pace: the fastest (+57 %), and it runs cooler. MAILBOX shows each frame as soon as it is ready: a little less lag, but it takes performance from the game.
Forza Horizon 2 for the Xbox 360, recompiled for Android.
From an export or an automatic backup
FXAA smooths jagged edges with a cheap filter over the final image.
Hide the controls when a gamepad is used
High smooths more edges, the faint ones too, and softens the image a little.
How bright the highlights may get, in nits. Many phones report less than their screen shows: Auto uses at least 1000.
How bright white menus and the HUD are, in nits. With HDR on, Android\'s brightness slider does not change the game: set it here.
How far objects cast shadows: nearly all of their cost is there. Far is the game\'s own.
How far the scene\'s brightest lights (sun, headlights, reflections) go above the white, up to the screen\'s peak. The HUD stays at the white. Native renderer only.
How much of the Xbox 360\'s original resolution the game draws, in 12.5 % steps. Below 100 % the image is less sharp and the GPU works much less.
How much of the Xbox 360\'s original resolution the game draws, effects and HUD included. Below 100 % the image is less sharp and the GPU works much less.
How often the shadow maps are redrawn. Every 2 frames costs less and is hardly noticed.
How the image is enlarged to the screen\'s size. Off shows the chosen resolution as it is, pixelated, with no filter. FSR is sharper when the resolution is below 100 %; CAS only sharpens.
Image stretched to the whole screen
Import a driver\'s .zip for Adreno GPUs (Turnip or Qualcomm\'s). Before a driver is used, the app tests whether it works on this GPU. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Gives the fastest core to the game\'s busiest part instead of the graphics one. It may help in heavy scenery. Only with the option above on.
Keeps the game on the processor\'s fastest cores only, and the very fastest for the part that drives the graphics (+16 %).
Locks the GPU clock instead of letting the system adjust it. Only with Turnip on an Adreno GPU. It does not always help: check with the FPS counter.
Logs and device information in a .zip, to look into a problem. Nothing is sent.
Makes the phone vibrate when the gamepad vibrates. Intensity follows the game.
Measure the GPU in the logs
MSAA 2x/4x smooths the scene\'s edges better but weighs on the GPU; FXAA is a light filter over the final image.
Native (recommended): draws the game straight on the GPU, without emulating the Xbox 360\'s. Much faster; it may still have a few image errors.

Next game only: after 60 s of play, measures for 10 s where the game spends the processor and saves it in the session log, which goes into the report. Needs root: the permission prompt shows when you turn it on, not during the game. Measures only.
No root: the phone is not rooted or the permission was denied. The performance profile will not be recorded.
No root: the phone is not rooted or the permission was denied. The usual diagnostics are still available.
No save to import in jogos/
Off: the game waits for each new graphics effect to be ready, which can stutter. On: it goes on without waiting, with less stutter, but an object may vanish or flicker for a moment.
Off: the Xbox 360\'s 16:9 image, with black bars. On: fills the screen, but distorts the image.
On: the game\'s sound is processed apart and spares the processor, but on some devices it stutters or sounds robotic. Off: as before. Takes effect the next time the game starts.
Opening the driver and creating a Vulkan device…
Opens the driver the way the game does and checks it has what the game needs. It runs apart: a driver that crashes does not close the app.
Pick the renderer: the options below are its own.
Use at least one letter or digit.
Up to 15 letters, digits or spaces. It is the name the game shows.
Put every control back in its original place and size?
Read straight from the file: no extracting or copying
Graphics and Performance back to how they came. The chosen GPU driver stays.
Every Graphics and Performance option goes back to its default, and the renderer back to Native. The chosen GPU driver does not change.
Reuses the already prepared geometry data that has not changed since the previous frame, instead of preparing it again.
Reuses the geometry that has not changed since the previous frame instead of sending it to the GPU again: 87 % less data and up to +35 % FPS.
Sharper textures seen at an angle, like the road in the distance.
Picks the resolution and FSR in one go: from Mega quality (100 %) to Ultra performance (33 %).
Show GPU, CPU and RAM use
Size of the final image on the screen (the native one is %1$s×%2$s). The game renders the same way.
Size of the sun\'s shadows. Smaller makes shadow edges blurrier and eases the GPU; 0 turns shadows off. Applied when the game starts.
Smooths jagged edges. MSAA is the game\'s own and the heaviest (off gives +91 %; 2x is lighter than 4x, +37 %); FXAA is a light filter over the final image.
Tap a control to pick it · drag to move it · pinch to resize it
Tells Android when the game needs more power, so it speeds up the processor at the right time.
The driver crashed the test process while opening.
The driver is no longer installed
The driver leaves the phone and the game goes back to the system driver.
the driver must be an Android ARM64 library (.so), not a PC or 32-bit one
the driver .so is empty or unreadable
The driver test took over 20 seconds
the file is not an Xbox 360 disc image
The final image and what shows over it.
The folder must have default.xex, XMediaFacade_default.xex, SpeechFacade_default.xex and media.
The game can use this driver.
Draws the scene in one go instead of in parts: less work for the processor (+25 %). Only works with anti-aliasing off or on FXAA.
The game files and your progress.
The game folder has an invalid name.
The game folder has an invalid path.
The game may not start with it. Use it anyway?
The game may not start with this driver.
The most frames per second; 30 is the Xbox 360\'s. Above it the game shows more frames if the device keeps up. Start screens and loadings may reach twice the limit. More frames mean more heat.
The game\'s language and this app\'s.
The GPU starts the frame\'s next step without waiting for the previous one to finish. The image is the same.
The imported driver did not load (one of its libraries is missing, or it is not for this GPU) and the system used the stock driver instead.
The list comes from the game itself: open the game once and it shows up here.
The processor and the GPU driver.
The report is no longer there. Make another.
The save from %1$s replaces the current one. The current one stays in the automatic backup of the last time the game started.
The screen\'s HDR mode. The white follows Android\'s brightness, and the highlights go up to the peak the screen allows at the moment. Off by default.
The screen\'s HDR mode, with the game\'s image at the white chosen below and its highlights above it. Off by default.
There is no app to save files.
They are stored, but the game does not apply them yet.

This app was recompiled from the %1$s edition and your default.xex is from another one (SHA-256 %2$s…). The game does not run with another edition.\n\nUse a copy of the %1$s edition (the SHA-256 of its default.xex starts with %3$s).
this driver needs Android API %1$s or newer (this is %2$s)
This menu and the touch controls panel.
⚠ This device\'s GPU lacks a feature the emulated renderer needs: with it the game does not start. Use the native renderer.
Steer with two arrows instead of the stick
Two arrows on the left of the screen, instead of the stick, as in other racing games. Holding one turns the wheel little by little.
How far the arrows turn the wheel at most.
To find the game, the app needs access to your files: tap Use the game ISO or Choose the game folder below, and Android will ask for it.
Turned off, it breaks the game: only the bottom band of the screen shows, with black and grey bands above.
Turnip and Qualcomm drivers are for Adreno GPUs only: with this GPU, use the system driver.
Under the FPS: GPU use; the game\'s processor use and that of its busiest part (near 100 %, it is what limits the FPS); the game\'s memory and the free memory, in GB.
What happened? How to reproduce it? (optional)
Draws the scene in one go instead of in parts: less work for the processor (+25 %).
How many people there are and how far away they are drawn. It weighs the most at the festival. Off: no crowd, with the native renderer.

1x is the Xbox 360\'s. Above it the world looks fuller and the frame rate drops; below it the game runs faster. Applied when the game starts; grass, and turning shadows and the crowd off, with the native renderer.
How far away bushes and tufts are drawn. Off: none, and the game runs faster. Native renderer only.
With MSAA, bushes and leaves get soft edges (alpha to coverage), but on a phone they look grainy, like flour. Off: firm edges, as without MSAA. Native renderer only.
How far away buildings, trees and props keep their detail.
What the car\'s paint and mirrors reflect, and how far. Off: the car reflects nothing live, faster, and the paint looks flat.
How far away shadows are drawn. Off: no shadows, with the native renderer. Below 1x, the native renderer leaves out the shadows of trees and bushes (faster).

Writes every repetition of the messages that repeat many times a second (renderer textures, unimplemented functions). Off, each shows only its first 20 times, and the log keeps more play time. For investigating only.
Writes to the log how long the GPU spends on each part of the frame. For investigating only: it slows the game down, since each measurement makes the GPU wait.
Passes only where the game draws
Each pass loads and stores only the rectangle its draws use, not the whole 1280x720 image: the small bloom passes stop moving the whole image through memory. Turn it off to compare.
Reflection mips in one pass per level
Draws the reflections\' smaller versions all together instead of one by one. The image does not change; it eases the GPU.
For tests: game options such as --name=value, separated by spaces. They go after the launcher\'s own, so they win. Leave empty to play normally.
The car reflections are redrawn a third at a time, the whole picture every 3 frames, instead of entirely every frame: much less work for the GPU. They may lag a little behind fast changes.

Unstable: may make the motion less smooth and gave no FPS gain in tests. The image is sent to the screen by a separate thread, so the game starts the next frame without waiting for it. Leave it off unless you are testing.
